_about: The year-wheel diagram (important-days; WHEEL-2 and WHEEL-3, 2026-10-08): the days Bangladesh observes, as the Cabinet Division's circular of 11 March 2026 and its four amendments list them, each date checked against a second official source where one exists; religious days removed by the user; two kinds; no year shown. Built by tools/build-diagram-important-days.mjs; tools/.cache/days/investigation.md (out of git) has the research. Every Bengali string awaits the user's approval.
